reporting_rules: Never merge independent_quality and author_route_alignment into one score.
A different route may be high quality even when gold event overlap is low.
The original target chapter participates as an anonymous candidate in quality judging.
If the original target does not satisfy the same public idea contract, keep it diagnostic-only; its hard-gate failure is a benchmark-spec mismatch, not a model win.
Judge forward and reversed candidate orders; inconsistent winner means judge_uncertain.
Human preference is the final evidence for whether generated text approaches or exceeds the original.
